verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly documents issuing scoped API tokens with fine-grained permissions (read-only, read-write, custom), OAuth2 flows requiring approval for third-party access, and the ability to revoke access anytime from the dashboard — directly supporting least-privilege credential issuance for agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of granularity (e.g. exact permission scopes available), and no explicit documentation of per-agent credential rotation or expiry policies.
